entries.embedded_english: Miller…

targets.initial_translation: 米勒！

entries.embedded_english:
<normal> Alright, what do we have here… 
*looking at clipboard*
Turner…

targets.initial_translation: 好，看看都来了谁。点名，答到。特纳！

entries.embedded_english: Great…

targets.initial_translation: 不错，又来一个模范大兵。

entries.embedded_english: subtitle_missing

targets.initial_translation: 我们本以为靠自己能打赢这场仗。

entries.embedded_english: subtitle_missing

targets.initial_translation: 我们错了。

entries.embedded_english: Now the other window, Miller…

targets.initial_translation: 换那个窗户，米勒！

entries.embedded_english: Woohoo! Goodnight!

targets.initial_translation: 晚安咯！

entries.embedded_english: Outstanding, Miller.

targets.initial_translation: 太出色了，米勒！

entries.embedded_english: Damn, would you look at that!  Bet they’ve been sneaking off the island for days!

targets.initial_translation: 妈的，你瞧瞧！这帮家伙肯定偷跑了好几天了。

entries.embedded_english: Thousands of ‘em, I reckon.

targets.initial_translation: 我看得有好几千人。

entries.embedded_english: Can't say I'm sorry to see 'em go.

targets.initial_translation: 要我说，滚了正好。

entries.embedded_english: Don't celebrate yet, Polonsky.  Every one of those Japanese you see escaping?  We'll be facing them all again on the next island...

targets.initial_translation: 把你那玩意儿收起来，波隆斯基。看见他们一个个跑了吧？猜怎么着？下个岛还要见。

entries.embedded_english: Hell, we whooped ‘em once, we can whup ‘em again…

targets.initial_translation: 哼，我赌我们能再揍他一顿。

entries.embedded_english: (On radio) Sullivan reporting, sir.  Happy to report, the Tokyo Express no longer comes to the end of the line at Guadalcanal...

targets.initial_translation: 东京快车已瘫痪。

entries.embedded_english: Come on, Marines! Let's go up there and give them hell.

targets.initial_translation: 上啊，弟兄们！冲上去狠狠揍他们！

entries.embedded_english: Stick a charge on that AA, Miller.

targets.initial_translation: 米勒，给那门高射炮装上炸药。

entries.embedded_english: And another…

targets.initial_translation: 再来一个！

entries.embedded_english: Okay - on three, I want you to move through these stables and take out the targets.

targets.initial_translation: 好，数到三，你穿过这些马厩，把靶子打掉。

entries.embedded_english: 1… 2… 3.  Go, go, go!

targets.initial_translation: 一、二、三，冲！冲！冲！

entries.embedded_english: Get amove on,  Miller. Under the net and through the obstacles - go, go !

targets.initial_translation: 快点，米勒！钻过网，越过障碍！快！快！

entries.embedded_english: Miller, take out that mortar crew!

targets.initial_translation: 米勒，干掉那个迫击炮组！

entries.embedded_english: Someone get Miller out of that mud!

targets.initial_translation: 谁去把米勒从泥里拉出来！

entries.embedded_english: I'm not running out into the open. We need some smoke to mask us!

targets.initial_translation: 我们没掩体！用烟幕弹！

entries.embedded_english: Get in there!  Move it.

targets.initial_translation: 进去，快点！

entries.embedded_english: Miller. Where the hell is your rifle?

targets.initial_translation: 你的枪呢，陆战队员？

entries.embedded_english: Sir Yes Sir!

targets.initial_translation: 到，长官！

entries.embedded_english: Watch it.  Here he comes…

targets.initial_translation: 别说了，他来了！

entries.embedded_english: Okay.  To aim better, you can look down the rifle's sight, but otherwise, just point it toward the target and pull the trigger!

targets.initial_translation: 记住，谁都会举枪射击。想像个真正的战士那样瞄准，就要端稳步枪，看准瞄具。

entries.embedded_english: Sarge, they're dug in tight around this one.

targets.initial_translation: 中士，他们那儿守得太严了！

entries.embedded_english: Damn right! Now let’s finish this!

targets.initial_translation: 没错！把它干完！

entries.embedded_english: Miller! Get on that Machine Gun and give us some covering fire!

targets.initial_translation: 米勒，去操纵那挺机枪，掩护我们！

entries.embedded_english: Miller, I'm talking to you.  Get over here!

targets.initial_translation: 米勒，我在跟你说话。过来，孩子。

entries.embedded_english: So what's this new sarge like?

targets.initial_translation: 嘿，麦克，新来的头儿有什么说法？

entries.embedded_english: Word has it that he's a real ball breaker…

targets.initial_translation: 听说那家伙是个狠角色。

entries.embedded_english: Attennnnshun!

targets.initial_translation: 是新来的兵，罗巴克中士。

entries.embedded_english: Here are the new recruits,  Sargeant Sullivan.

targets.initial_translation: 立正！

entries.embedded_english: Polonsky…

targets.initial_translation: 波隆斯基！

entries.embedded_english: Sir Yes Sir!

targets.initial_translation: 到，长官！

entries.embedded_english: Get over to that table and pick up a rifle, Miller…

targets.initial_translation: 去那张桌子拿支步枪，米勒。跑起来！

entries.embedded_english: The rest of you, move to that rifle range.  I want to see just how much much I've got to do here.

targets.initial_translation: 其余的人去靶场练空枪。

entries.embedded_english: Smoke grenades next.  You'll use them to hide your movements on the battlefield and to confuse the enemy.  Take a few and throw one through the top floor window in that barn.

targets.initial_translation: 接下来是烟幕弹。用它遮住你的行动，让敌人摸不清。拿几个，往那间谷仓的顶层窗户扔一个。

entries.embedded_english: Don't think I'm letting you off with forgetting your rifle, Miller. One lap round the hill.  I'll be waiting at the finish line.

targets.initial_translation: 米勒，忘带枪这事我可不会就这么算了。绕小山跑一圈，我在终点等你。

entries.embedded_english: Ok, the smokes down, Go Go Go!

targets.initial_translation: 好，烟冒起来了！冲！冲！冲！

entries.embedded_english: Hey, Sarge - I got a tunnel here.

targets.initial_translation: 中士，我这下面有个地道。

entries.embedded_english: Anderson, Burn it out. Everyone, stay back.

targets.initial_translation: 安德森，去把它烧了。都退后。

entries.embedded_english: What are you waiting for, Miller? Get in there!

targets.initial_translation: 还等什么，米勒？要我下请帖吗？快去！

entries.embedded_english: Oh you really are the best of the best aren't you Miller?  GET IN THERE!

targets.initial_translation: 哦，你真是精英中的精英啊，米勒？上啊！

entries.embedded_english: C'mon, buddy.  We're holding 'em!

targets.initial_translation: 顶住，兄弟！有我们掩护！

entries.embedded_english: Polonsky!  Get some smoke up there. Anderson, Miller when the smoke hits, get in cover near the top!

targets.initial_translation: 波隆斯基，往上面打烟！安德森、米勒，烟一起来就到上面找掩体！

entries.embedded_english: You think we've got all day, Miller?  Pick up your Thompson.

targets.initial_translation: 米勒，你以为我们有一整天？把你的汤普森拿上。快点快点，走。

entries.embedded_english: Miller, there's a Thompson on that table. Get it now.

targets.initial_translation: 米勒！桌上那把汤普森，马上拿！

entries.embedded_english: Okay, last  AA gun. Get a charge on it, Miller.

targets.initial_translation: 好，最后一门高射炮。米勒，去装炸药。

entries.embedded_english: Trenches, ahead of us!  Watch for enemy activity!

targets.initial_translation: 看那些船，他们要跑了！

entries.embedded_english: Look up there!

targets.initial_translation: 嘿，上面！

entries.embedded_english: Damn, that's one of our fly-boys...He's ditching it!

targets.initial_translation: 糟了，那是我们的飞机！他要在水上迫降了！

entries.embedded_english: Until we take out those AA guns, we can forget about air-support, guys.

targets.initial_translation: 我直说吧，不把那炮干掉，就别指望空中支援了。

entries.embedded_english: Not bad, Miller, not bad at all.  You might make it after all.

targets.initial_translation: 还行，米勒。说不定能把你练成个好兵。

entries.embedded_english: Let see how you are with grenades.  Go get some from the table there…

targets.initial_translation: 好，看看你手榴弹玩得怎么样。去那边桌子拿几个。

entries.embedded_english: Ok.  Miller, shoot the helmets off the scarecrows.

targets.initial_translation: 好，米勒。把稻草人上的钢盔打下来。

entries.embedded_english: Okay, good…

targets.initial_translation: 好，不错。

entries.embedded_english: Okay, that's grenades. Follow me to the assault course

targets.initial_translation: 好，手榴弹就到这。跟我去突击训练场。

entries.embedded_english: I want suppressing fire on that hill!

targets.initial_translation: 给我压制那个山头！

entries.embedded_english: Get up, Miller.  You're not dead yet…

targets.initial_translation: 起来，米勒！我没说你死，你就不许倒下！

entries.embedded_english: Anderson - I want some flame on that bunker.  Get up that hill and get on it.

targets.initial_translation: 安德森，那个碉堡给我烧了。爬上山去，动手！

entries.embedded_english: Miller, you go with him.

targets.initial_translation: 米勒，你跟着他。

entries.embedded_english: We gotta keep moving, Marines! Get up there!

targets.initial_translation: 继续走，弟兄们！往上冲！

entries.embedded_english: Arrrrrrrr!  Storm the hill

targets.initial_translation: 冲啊！拿下山头！

entries.embedded_english: Nice work. Anderson -  go and check it out.

targets.initial_translation: 干得好！安德森，过去看看！

entries.embedded_english: TRIPWIRE!

targets.initial_translation: 有绊雷！

entries.embedded_english: Argh!
Anderson!  Damn it!

targets.initial_translation: 安德森！可恶！

entries.embedded_english: Miller, get that flame thrower and take point.

targets.initial_translation: 米勒，去拿上火焰喷射器，然后……

entries.embedded_english: Get in there, Marines! Go go!

targets.initial_translation: 上，弟兄们！冲！冲！冲！

entries.embedded_english: Wow, excellent fruit-killing skills you've got there Miller!  Now stop messing around

targets.initial_translation: 哟，米勒，打水果倒是挺有一手啊。别瞎闹了！

entries.embedded_english: The targets are over here, soldier!

targets.initial_translation: 靶子在这边，大兵。

entries.embedded_english: Don’t get too excited, Marine.  Real targets move.....and fire back at you...

targets.initial_translation: 别得意，陆战队员。真靶子会动，还会朝你开枪。

entries.embedded_english: Not bad.. Not bad at all...

targets.initial_translation: 不错，相当不错。

entries.embedded_english: Polonsky, take care of that room.

targets.initial_translation: 波隆斯基，那间屋交给你。

entries.embedded_english: Clearing room sir…

targets.initial_translation: 安全了！

entries.embedded_english: Take covering positions!

targets.initial_translation: 各就各位，准备掩护！

entries.embedded_english: Miller, get out of the way of the flames!

targets.initial_translation: 米勒，躲开火焰！

entries.embedded_english: Oh yeah baby, now they’re in trouble!

targets.initial_translation: 太棒了！这下他们完蛋了！

entries.embedded_english: Let's go men! Move move move!

targets.initial_translation: 走，弟兄们！动起来！动起来！

entries.embedded_english: Miller, get over here and shoot these targets.

targets.initial_translation: 米勒！过来打这些靶子！

entries.embedded_english: Miller, are you making the big mistake of intentionally trying to get on the wrong side of me?

targets.initial_translation: 米勒，你再这样，看我怎么收拾你。听明白了吗？

entries.embedded_english: MILLER! - Get over here,  that's an order!

targets.initial_translation: 米勒！给我过来，这是命令！

entries.embedded_english: The narrow end is where the bullet comes from Miller, now get shooting!

targets.initial_translation: 米勒，带孔的那头才是子弹出来的地方。赶紧开枪！

entries.embedded_english: Sir, they've got us pinned down here.  We're gonna get cut to pieces, unless someone knocks out those MGs!

targets.initial_translation: 中士，我们被压制住了！

entries.embedded_english: Keep your heads down!

targets.initial_translation: 都低头。

entries.embedded_english: Sir, Command says 161st has Shermans inbound on our location

targets.initial_translation: 指挥部说第161团的谢尔曼坦克正往我们这边来。

entries.embedded_english: Woo-hoo!  Looks like the cavalry's here!

targets.initial_translation: 咱们的救兵到了，弟兄们！

entries.embedded_english: Hey, Armor’s arrived!  Ooh-rah!

targets.initial_translation: 我们的坦克到了！好啊！

entries.embedded_english: They're dug in tight around the AA gun.  We need to go through them to take out that AA!

targets.initial_translation: 他们守得很死，要突破他们的防线才能干掉那些火炮。

entries.embedded_english: Okay.  This must be Tenaro village… We need to press on through it and take out those  AA guns.

targets.initial_translation: 这应该就是特纳罗村。得穿过这片乱摊子，把那些高射炮拔掉。

entries.embedded_english: The Japanese have levelled the village.  Now they're using the ruins for cover.

targets.initial_translation: 日本人把村子炸平了。这帮鬼子就拿废墟当掩体。

entries.embedded_english: They don't give up easy, do they?  Keep pushing them back, guys!

targets.initial_translation: 这帮家伙还真顽强。弟兄们，继续把他们往后压。

entries.embedded_english: See that window on the ground floor?  Toss a frag grenade through it.

targets.initial_translation: 看见一楼那个窗户没？往里扔颗手雷！

entries.embedded_english: You're up first, Miller.  Pick up a Thompson from that table…

targets.initial_translation: 你先上，米勒。去桌上拿把汤普森。

entries.embedded_english: Alright, Marines, move on to the close quarters range… Follow me…

targets.initial_translation: 好，弟兄们，去近战靶场。跟我走。

entries.embedded_english: Let's have a recap of some basic combat maneuvers, demonstrated by Miller , of course…

targets.initial_translation: 好，复习一下基本战术动作。跟训练营里一样。米勒，你来做示范。

entries.embedded_english: Don't worry Miller, I'll be there every step of the way…

targets.initial_translation: 别担心，米勒。我会一路带着你。

entries.embedded_english: Get some fire in there!

targets.initial_translation: 往里面打！

entries.embedded_english: ooh- Rah!  Nice and toasty eh boys?

targets.initial_translation: 把你们这帮狗东西烤了！

entries.embedded_english: Knock it off polonsky, Miller, get over there and clear it out. The rest of you stack up and wait for my signal

targets.initial_translation: 行了，波隆斯基。米勒，你过去清理。其他人列队准备突入，等我信号。

entries.embedded_english: Stop flailing around.  Hey Fletch, I think this one's drowning - grab him!

targets.initial_translation: 别乱扑腾了行不行？嘿，弗莱奇，我看这家伙要淹死了。抓住他！

entries.embedded_english: Argh!  He's over there!

targets.initial_translation: 啊！那狗东西在那边！

entries.embedded_english: Nice shot!

targets.initial_translation: 干得漂亮！

entries.embedded_english: This can’t be happening...

targets.initial_translation: 这不可能！
